title: stardust coverage/templates.json
description: Template coverage ledger. A template is the design structure shared by a set of pages (a typed archetype + its canon). Tracks archetype-approval status, the pages it governs, the blocks it composes, and migration/delivery coverage. Owned by stardust:site.

id.description: Template identity. May equal the page type, or differentiate multiple archetypes of one type (e.g. landing-home vs landing-campaign).

type.description: The stardust page type this template specializes. Catalog is per-site and extensible at direct --prep.

status.description: candidate (inferred) -> confirmed (user-accepted) -> archetype-approved (representative prototype approved) -> canon-folded (folded into stardust/canon).

archetypeSlug.description: The representative page whose approved prototype defines this template (Path A' source for siblings).

blocks.description: Block ids this template composes. References coverage/blocks.json[].id.

coverage.description: Counts of this template's pages that have reached each milestone. Percentages are pageCount-relative.

depth.description: Representative depth across this template's pages (typically the min, so 'done' means every page reached it).
